name: Meguro Writer
author: kenget

sections.description:
Meguro Writer uses the Google Gemini API and Google Search grounding to discover current information, generate news articles, and publish them to WordPress on a configurable schedule.

The plugin is designed for general-purpose use across different media sites. You can configure the target countries and regions, article language, search language, editorial style, post type, taxonomy, publishing status, author, image generation, and publishing schedule.

Main features:

  • Discover current news with Google Search grounding.
  • Configure custom search topics such as technology, business, finance, real estate, entertainment, politics, and local news.
  • Configure the media name, AI role, target audience, article purpose, tone, and additional instructions.
  • Select article language and search language independently.
  • Target up to 10 countries or regions at the same time.
  • Use regional groups such as Southeast Asia, East Asia, the Middle East, North America, Europe, Russia/CIS, Latin America, Africa, and Oceania.
  • Use a global mode that searches worldwide while prioritizing selected countries and regions.
  • Target the United States nationally or by state and Washington, D.C.
  • Target China nationally or by province, municipality, or autonomous region.
  • Treat Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao as separate selectable targets in the plugin’s news-targeting interface.
  • Adjust editorial selection with six 10-level sliders: entertainment, politics, freshness, regional focus, audience gender balance, and tone.
  • Configure excluded topics, source preferences, and additional AI prompts.
  • Choose a WordPress post type as the publishing destination.
  • Enter a custom post type slug manually when it is not listed automatically.
  • Auto-detect, select, or manually enter a taxonomy slug.
  • Choose Publish, Draft, Pending Review, or Private as the target post status.
  • Choose the WordPress author account used for generated posts.
  • Configure a separate schedule for each day of the week, with up to 15 publishing times per day.
  • Use the Monthly Publishing Plan to override individual date/time slots with a specific topic, skip action, or extra one-time post.
  • Detect duplicate source URLs and similar titles.
  • Configure minimum relevance, confidence, and news freshness.
  • Configure minimum article length and structured H2 sections.
  • Write Yoast SEO meta description and focus keyphrase data when applicable.
  • Enable or disable the summary-points block and source box.
  • Generate 16:9 featured images with Gemini image generation.
  • Optionally use up to three reference images for image generation.
  • Use a common featured image as a fallback when image generation is unavailable.
  • Optionally map data to ACF or postmeta custom fields.
  • Export and import the complete plugin configuration and Monthly Publishing Plan as JSON.
  • View execution logs, send failure notifications, run a manual post, and test the Gemini API connection.

Support contact: kenget0616@gmail.com

Updating from earlier versions

Starting with version 3.1.3, the official distribution folder and main plugin file are meguro-writer/meguro-writer.php.

When Meguro Writer is activated while an earlier kt-ai-news or livplus-ai-news plugin is active, Meguro Writer deactivates the earlier plugin. Existing settings, monthly-plan data, log tables, and generated-post metadata are retained.

After confirming that the new plugin works correctly, the old kt-ai-news and/or livplus-ai-news folder can be removed.

Some internal option names, database table names, legacy metadata keys, and compatibility aliases remain available to avoid breaking existing installations.

Settings backup and restore

Open Meguro Writer > Settings Backup to export or import the plugin configuration in JSON format.

The backup includes:

  • General settings and publishing destination.
  • AI editorial rules and slider values.
  • Article language, search language, target countries and regions, and United States/China subregion settings.
  • Search topics, image settings, SEO settings, and notifications.
  • Weekly publishing schedule.
  • Monthly Publishing Plan.
  • Custom-field mappings.

The Gemini API key is excluded by default. It is included only when the administrator explicitly enables the option to export it.

When importing settings into another site, WordPress user IDs, media attachment IDs, post types, taxonomies, and custom-field structures may differ. Review the settings after import.

External services

Meguro Writer uses Google Gemini API / Google AI services for news discovery, article generation, image generation, and API connection tests.

Activating the plugin alone does not send requests to Google. Requests are made when an administrator configures an API key and runs a connection test, manual generation, or scheduled generation.

Data that may be sent to Google includes administrator-configured search topics, prompts and editorial instructions, selected language and geographic targeting, news information gathered for article generation, optional reference URLs, image-generation instructions, and reference images when the reference-image feature is enabled.

Meguro Writer is not designed to collect ordinary site visitors’ personal information and send it to Gemini.

Service: Google AI for Developers / Gemini API
https://ai.google.dev/

Gemini API Additional Terms of Service:
https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google may apply different data-handling terms depending on the Gemini API plan or service tier. Review the current terms and privacy policy before using the service with confidential or personal information.

Privacy

Meguro Writer does not include its own analytics, telemetry, or usage tracking.

When Gemini API features are used, data described in the External services section is sent to Google for generation or search-related processing.

If a settings backup is exported with the Gemini API key included, the resulting JSON file contains confidential credentials and must be stored securely.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the Meguro Writer ZIP file and activate the plugin.
  3. Open Meguro Writer > Settings.

  4. Configure your Gemini API key. The key can be stored in the database, but defining it in wp-config.php is recommended:

    define(‘MEGURO_WRITER_GEMINI_API_KEY’, ‘YOUR_API_KEY’);

Earlier API-key constants are also supported for backward compatibility:

define('KT_AI_NEWS_GEMINI_API_KEY', 'YOUR_API_KEY');

define('LIVPLUS_GEMINI_API_KEY', 'YOUR_API_KEY');
  1. Configure the article language, search language, target countries or regions, publishing destination, search topics, audience, editorial settings, and schedule.
  2. Run the Gemini API connection test.
  3. Use the manual single-post generation action before enabling automated publishing.
sections.faq:
Does Meguro Writer automatically create new categories?

No. The plugin selects from existing terms in the configured taxonomy. A configured fallback term can be used when no suitable existing term is returned.

Will WordPress Cron always run at the exact configured time?

WP-Cron is triggered by site traffic and may not execute at an exact time. For production sites that require predictable schedules, use a server cron job or another scheduler to call wp-cron.php regularly.

Is the Gemini API key included in configuration backups?

Not by default. It is included only when the administrator explicitly enables the API-key export option.

Can I publish international news in Japanese?

Yes. Geographic targeting and article language are independent. For example, you can target the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada while generating the final articles in Japanese.

How are Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao handled?

In the Meguro Writer targeting interface, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao are separate selectable targets and are not included in the China province/subregion selector.

Can I prioritize several countries while still searching globally?

Yes. Use Global mode and select up to 10 priority countries or regions. The regional-focus slider controls how strongly those selected targets are prioritized relative to worldwide news.
sections.changelog:
3.1.3

  • Renamed the plugin to Meguro Writer and changed the distribution slug/text domain to meguro-writer.
  • Added migration compatibility for earlier plugin installations.
  • Made scheduled-slot and process locking atomic to prevent duplicate posts during concurrent cron requests.

3.1.2

  • Fixed WordPress Plugin Check database-preparation errors by using identifier placeholders for custom log-table queries.
  • Replaced the duplicate-source direct SQL query with the WordPress post query API.
  • Rewrote the WordPress.org readme in standard English.
  • Updated internal PHP class names to use the Meguro Writer prefix while retaining legacy class aliases for backward compatibility.
  • Removed the manual load_plugin_textdomain() call because WordPress.org loads plugin translations automatically.
  • Improved settings import file validation and read-only monthly-plan request handling.

3.1.1

  • Replaced heredoc strings to satisfy WordPress.org Plugin Check requirements.
  • Added the Tested up to readme header.
  • Removed unexpected root Markdown documentation from the WordPress.org distribution ZIP.

3.1.0

  • Added independent article-language and search-language settings.
  • Added up to 10 selectable target countries or regions.
  • Added regional groups for Southeast Asia, the Middle East, East Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, North America, Europe, Russia/CIS, Latin America, Africa, and Oceania.
  • Added Selected Targets mode and Global + Priority Targets mode.
  • Added United States national/state/Washington, D.C. targeting.
  • Added China national/province/municipality/autonomous-region targeting.
  • Added Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao as separate targeting entries in the plugin interface.
  • Reworked the former Japan-specific location slider into a dynamic regional-focus slider.
  • Applied language and geographic targeting to news discovery, article generation, and image generation.
  • Added localized standard content labels for major article languages.
  • Included the new language and geographic settings in configuration backup and restore.

3.0.0

  • Changed the official distribution slug to kt-ai-news and the main file to kt-ai-news.php.
  • Added migration handling for the legacy livplus-ai-news plugin.
  • Added complete settings and Monthly Publishing Plan JSON export/import.
  • Added optional API-key export.
  • Added a Settings Backup admin screen and support contact information.
  • Added GPLv2-or-later licensing metadata.
  • Documented Gemini API usage as an external service.

2.1.0

  • Added the Monthly Publishing Plan as a separate admin screen.
  • Added a date-by-time monthly matrix based on the weekly schedule.
  • Added per-slot topic overrides and skip actions.
  • Added extra one-time publishing slots outside the normal weekly schedule.
  • Stored only monthly exceptions so untouched slots continue to follow weekly schedule changes.
  • Added per-slot topic, instruction, reference URL, and category settings.

2.0.1

  • Added six 10-level editorial preference sliders.
  • Applied editorial slider values to news selection, article generation, and image direction.

2.0.0

  • Renamed the plugin to Meguro Writer.
  • Generalized the original real-estate-specific prompts for arbitrary topics.
  • Added configurable post type, taxonomy, post status, and author.
  • Added KT_AI_NEWS_GEMINI_API_KEY while retaining the legacy constant for compatibility.
